episodes.199685: A deepening low pressure system tracked northeastwards along the North Carolina Coast during the night of March tenth into the morning of March eleventh before pulling away from the area. As this occurred, shower and scattered thunderstorm activity associated with this low tracked northeastwards as well bringing strong wind gusts, frequent lightning, and locally elevated seas to our coastal waters south of Ocracoke Inlet.
episodes.201294: A strong area of low pressure transitioned over the region and brought heavy rain, mountain snow, and some strong and gusty winds for the higher elevations and deserts.
episodes.203158: Minor runoff and sheet flooding west of Idaho Falls along Highway 20 and through Madison County.

ITD reported minor flooding encroaching the shoulder of Highway 20 west of Idaho Falls due to increased snowmelt in that area.

Madison County EM reported minor snowmelt flooding coming from an elevated bench area east of Thornton. The water was cascading down the hill, pooling into farm fields adjoining the neighborhoods and threatening to inundate homes. Sandbagging prevented further property damage to homes.
